stock.description: Archosaur Games Inc. operates as an investment holding entity primarily engaged in the creation and management of mobile games, serving both the domestic market in Mainland China and international audiences. The enterprise's core expertise lies in developing titles across diverse categories, including massively multiplayer online role-playing (MMORPGs), simulation games, female-oriented experiences, shooting games, and strategic card games, among others. Founded in 1997, its corporate headquarters are situated in Beijing, People's Republic of China.

provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.beta: FMP profile beta; lookback, frequency and benchmark unspecified by the response

provenance.cash: All reported cash and short-term investments assumed nonoperating; adjustable

provenance.priority: Preferred and minority book values are adjustable value proxies; cost defaults to common Ke
